Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Stage timing and logistics question for Aug 31 workshop

Hi Alex / team,

Quick note as we lock the venue run today — two asks that will affect final travel and deck deadlines:

1) Exact speaker on/off window for the main stage (we currently have 12m per speaker but the room AV has a 10m buffer). Can Redwood compress to 10m with a 1m intro/exit?
2) We need cue cards or a one-page speaker script for each presenter (to hand them backstage). Can you confirm who owns those and delivery ETA?

Also attaching the venue map and our tentative seating (see seatmap_v2.png). If you can confirm presenter names and whether any require special AV (lapel vs. handheld), we’ll finalize stage staffing.

Thanks,
Natalie Cruz
Events Producer — ACME Corp

Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage timing and logistics question for Aug 31 workshop

Natalie — thanks for the heads up. See proposals below and a delivery plan. I’ve attached a first draft of the cue cards (stage_cue_cards_v1.pdf) and a run-of-show grid (day1-run-of-show.xlsx).

Proposal (main stage):
- 10 minutes per presenter on the clock. We’ll aim for a 9:30 presentation window + 30s intro/30s exit. 1 minute buffer built into AV handoffs.
- If we get a 1-minute overrun we’ll compress Q&A. AV: lapel for all except the demo (handheld).

Speaker ownership (deliverables):
- Vivek Kulkarni — keynote framing + cue card (owner: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com) — deliver by Tue 7/27 EOD
- Karthik Iyer — product deep-dive deck + 2 slide demo script (owner: karthik_iyer@redwood.com) — deliver by Thu 7/29 EOD
- Marissa Cole — customer case overview + speaker note bullets (owner: marissa_cole@redwood.com) — deliver by Thu 7/29 EOD
- Vanessa Ortiz — onsite moderator notes and intro transitions (owner: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com) — deliver by Fri 7/30 EOD

Pre-read packaging: we recommend a single consolidated pre-read (6 pages max) with clear ‘must-read’ sections and an appendix. Alex will own collating assets and handing to ACME events.

Next steps: please confirm you’re happy with 10m windows and the owner list. I’ll compile the cue cards into final PDFs once owners send their 1-paragraph speaker notes.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Program Manager — Redwood Inference

Agree with Alex on the 10-minute windows. Couple of practical notes from a floor ops perspective:

- Seatmap: I updated the attendee seat mapping to reserve front two rows for executive guests and panelists (see attached seatmap_v2.png). Please flag any VIPs.
- Backstage flow: request that each presenter has a single handler. I'll assign staff once we have confirmed the final presenter list.
- Cue cards: simplest format is 3 bullets + 1 line ‘exit to’ note. I’ve added a sample card to the PDF Alex attached.

John Barrett (ACME) — can you confirm if any of your speakers will need a confidence monitor or teleprompter? That changes AV set-up time.

-Vanessa

Deck owners and deliverables:
- Karthik: product deck (10 slides) + 2 demo slides, note bullets (due Thu 7/29 EOD)
- Marissa: customer story deck (5 slides) + speaker bullets (due Thu 7/29 EOD)
- Vivek: opening deck (3 slides) + 1 paragraph talk opener (due Tue 7/27 EOD)

Gating ask: please upload final slide PDFs to the shared drive folder by 8/24 so AV can pre-load and we can do a tech run on 8/30 morning. If anyone needs extra slide formatting support, ping me — we can put a slide-polish slot on Fri 7/30.

On the cue-card format: I’ll provide the 2-slide demo script as a separate speaker note PDF so Alex can drop in the cue card template.

Subject: Final: Stage timing / cue cards / pre-read packaging — confirm by EOD 7/28

Thanks everyone — summarizing final commitments and next steps so ACME can lock AV and seating:

1) Timing — 10m per presenter confirmed (AV buffer included).
2) Deliverables (final by owner):
   - Vivek: 1-paragraph opener + PDF slides — DUE: Tue 7/27 EOD (please confirm delivered)
   - Karthik: product deck + demo notes — DUE: Thu 7/29 EOD
   - Marissa: customer story slides + bullets — DUE: Thu 7/29 EOD
   - Vanessa: moderator script + transition notes — DUE: Fri 7/30 EOD
3) Cue cards — Alex will collate speaker 1-paragraphs into individual cue cards and circulate final PDFs by Mon 8/2.
4) Pre-read — single consolidated PDF (6 pages max). I’ll draft the table of contents; owners should send 1–2 page contributions with clear callouts for execs.
5) AV gating — John / ACME Events to confirm confidence monitor needs by Fri 7/30. If teleprompter required we’ll schedule extra set-up time on 8/30.

Attachments referenced: stage_cue_cards_v1.pdf, day1-run-of-show.xlsx, seatmap_v2.png.

Please reply with a single line “ack” if you confirm these dates and owners by EOD today. If no reply I’ll assume owners listed will deliver on their dates and will escalate on 7/29 for any missing items.

Appreciate the quick turn — I’ll pull the pre-read TOC together tonight and share a draft by 7/29 morning.

—Alex
